items.text: Achieve ultimate analytical performance with SCIEX mass spectrometry software
SCIEX software solutions connect instruments, data, and people—turning complex analytical workflows into streamlined, compliant, and future‑ready laboratory operations.

When operating high‑performance LC‑MS/MS systems, scientists expect confidence in every result. SCIEX software solutions are comprehensive offerings of mass spectrometry software designed to help laboratories achieve ultimate analytical performance across research and routine LC‑MS/MS workflows. Built around SCIEX OS software as the core platform, SCIEX software solutions deliver fast, accurate, and conclusive results by unifying instrument control, method development, data processing, and compliance within a single, integrated software environment.
The right tool for the right job is what you want in your laboratory. Choose the SCIEX software you need for your specific workflows to improve efficiencies and increase productivity.
Our comprehensive portfolio of modern laboratory software helps you make the most of your mass spectrometry system.

SCIEX OS software is the engine that drives SCIEX mass spectrometry. It delivers powerful, intuitive control across the SCIEX portfolio—from nominal mass systems (triple quadrupole) to accurate mass systems (TOF)—while providing the tools you need to monitor performance, protect data quality, and maximize instrument uptime.

SCIEX OS software provides a modern, integrated environment for confident data processing across quantitative and qualitative mass spectrometry workflows. Designed to simplify review, improve consistency, and support defensible results, it helps laboratories process data efficiently while staying ready for what’s next.

The SCIEX biopharmaceutical software solution unites SCIEX OS software, Biologics Explorer software, and Genedata Expressionist—with PMI Byos compatibility—to streamline large‑molecule and oligonucleotide analysis from acquisition to interpretation, enabling faster, more automated, high‑confidence biologics workflows.

Embrace a new era of medicine with intuitive and flexible analytical solutions designed to deliver meaningful results. Reduce the complexity of developing gene-editing tools and next-generation vaccines with data-driven confidence.

Advanced discovery and structural analysis for omics workflows

SCIEX works in partnership with established third‑party software providers to support trusted omics data‑processing tools. Together, SCIEX OS software, Skyline, PEAKS, and MS‑DIAL help simplify complex discovery workflows, improve throughput and quantitative robustness, and enable higher‑confidence interpretation within proteomics, metabolomics, and lipidomics studies.

SCIEX software solutions support multiple omics workflows by combining SCIEX OS software with established third‑party software, including Skyline, PEAKS, and MS‑DIAL. When paired with ZT Scan DIA technology, this approach is designed to support advanced proteomics, metabolomics, and lipidomics discovery workflows, while maintaining continuity with familiar analysis tools.

Together, these tools form a modular and flexible software framework that supports multiple omics workflows, helping researchers simplify discovery, improve feature detection and structural interpretation, to accelerate biological insight.

Designed to simplify review, improve consistency, and support defensible results, it helps laboratories process data efficiently while staying ready for what’s next.

Built on industry-leading de novo sequencing enhanced by deep learning, PEAKS uniquely integrates spectral library and database search, PTM and sequence variant discovery, and robust quantification in a single, streamlined workflow - enabling researchers to uncover novel biology, maximize proteome coverage, and trust every result, whether working with IDA/DDA, Zeno SWATH or ZT Scan DIA, or targeted proteomics data.

Open‑source software for untargeted metabolomics and lipidomics, supporting peak detection, deconvolution, compound annotation, and statistical analysis in complex biological datasets. Optimized for SCIEX SWATH, ZT Scan DIA and EAD workflows, enabling improved precursor–fragment association and greater structural confidence for small‑molecule discovery.

A freely available and open-source Windows client application that allows you to process SCIEX raw data directly for building Selected Reaction Monitoring (SRM) / Multiple Reaction Monitoring (MRM), Parallel Reaction Monitoring (PRM), Data Independent Acquisition (DIA/SWATH), and DDA with MS1 quantitative methods and analyze the resulting mass spectrometer data. Its flexible configuration supports all molecules. It aims to employ cutting-edge technologies to create and iteratively refine targeted methods for large-scale quantitative mass spectrometry studies in life sciences.
Scale up your research to identify key genes, proteins, lipids and metabolites and easily integrate your data to find relevant insights.

Extraordinary discoveries demand extraordinary proof. The SCIEX ZenoTOF 8600 system combines proven technology from our most sensitive triple quad with that of our most versatile Zeno trap-enabled QTOF. Delivering up to 10x improvements in sensitivity* means achieving lower limits of quantitation and enabling enhanced performance across a multitude of accurate mass workflows.

As scientific discovery accelerates, the tools supporting your work must evolve just as quickly. That’s why SCIEX is beginning the end-of-support for Analyst software platform, a trusted solution for over 27 years.​​ This transition reflects our commitment to advancing capability and performance. SCIEX OS software is our next-generation software platform, built to meet the needs of modern labs. It offers streamlined workflows, enhanced compliance features, and full compatibility with Windows 11 (expected in Q3 2025).
The software is just as important as the hardware. The most recent SCIEX OS software is particularly user-friendly, making it ideal for day-to-day operation and training.
